description: This file defines formatting utility functions for terminal output, including colorized key-value pairs, separator formatting, tag styling, and text truncation. It exports functions for checking terminal capabilities, string padding, and various formatting functions utilizing theme-based colorization.

methods.name: isRich
methods.description: Determines if the terminal supports rich formatting based on environment conditions and user options.

methods.name: pad
methods.description: Pads a string to a specified length with trailing spaces.

methods.name: formatKey
methods.description: Formats a key string with optional colorization based on theme.

methods.name: formatValue
methods.description: Formats a value string with optional colorization based on theme.

methods.name: formatKeyValue
methods.description: Formats a key-value pair with optional colorization and returns a concatenated string.

methods.name: formatSeparator
methods.description: Returns a separator symbol with optional colorization.

methods.name: formatTag
methods.description: Formats tags with different styles based on their value and rich formatting flag.

methods.name: truncate
methods.description: Truncates a string to a maximum length, adding ellipsis if necessary.

ctags.name: formatKey
ctags.pattern: /^export const formatKey = (key: string, rich: boolean) => colorize(rich, theme.warn, key);$/

ctags.name: formatValue
ctags.pattern: /^export const formatValue = (value: string, rich: boolean) => colorize(rich, theme.info, value);$/

ctags.name: isRich
ctags.pattern: /^export const isRich = (opts?: { json?: boolean; plain?: boolean }) =>$/

ctags.name: pad
ctags.pattern: /^export const pad = (value: string, size: number) => value.padEnd(size);$/
